Security/compliance team requested SOC2 Type II, evidence of encryption-at-rest/ in-transit, HSM/KMS integration notes. Also asked for data residency confirmation for backups in us-east-1.
Commercial: initial Dedicated sizing estimate presented 2026-01-12; pricing is ~25% above internal target; exploring 12-month commit + committed usage discount. Procurement requires final MSA and DPA redline resolution before issuing PO.
